text:
priya: quick update — kicked off int4 quantization run for the new q6b candidate against promptset-alpha this morning. saw a ~6% drop on rerank recall and a few hallucination regressions on long-form prompts. attaching early diffs.
ash: can you paste the exact config you used? batch/ctx/seed? wondering if kv-cache handling differs for longctx.
priya: config: model=q6b, quant=int4, kernel=fastfused, ctx=2048, batch=8. used prefix-caching enabled. ran 5k sample sweep from promptset-alpha (mixed long+short). results -> /sweeps/q6b/int4/run_2026_03_22.log
noah: fyi tokenization changed slightly between v2 tokenizer -> v2.1, could cause dedupe fingerprint shifts. did you normalize whitespace before hashing?
maya: not yet — we just hashed raw input. that might explain some near-duplicates turning into false-uniques.
labelops-bot: reminder: label queue 42 is currently paused for golden refresh. ETA resume: ~48h.
eva: For the hallucination examples, are they concentrated on certain prompt templates? i can triage if you post a small batch.
priya: yes — mostly on 'context-append' templates with long histories (>=1500 tokens). i'll drop 40 examples into #eng-ml-artifacts in a sec.
ash: two suggestions: (1) rerun with caching disabled for kv-cache edgecases, (2) run a tokenizer-normalize -> fuzzyhash dedupe before sampling to keep golden stable.
sam: for labeling coordination: if we need to relabel golden, labelops can carve a micro-gold set and prioritize. need final sample list by EOD to avoid backlog.
maya: will do dedupe-normalize run and share new sample ids by 17:00 PT. also propose we add a 'longctx' flag in sample metadata so future quant runs can stratify.
noah: good call. also add tokenizer_rev=2.1 metadata so we can filter runs that used different tokenizers.
priya: action items so far: 1) maya -> run normalize+fuzzy dedupe and emit new sample list (owner: maya) 2) ash -> rerun small int4 sweep with caching disabled (owner: ash) 3) eva -> triage hallucination 40 examples and tag root cause (owner: eva) 4) sam/labelops -> prepare micro-golden carve and labeling priority (owner: sam) 5) noah -> add tokenizer_rev metadata to sampling pipeline (owner: noah).
sam: i can reserve a 200-sample microgold slot and assign 2 labelers — will confirm by 16:30.
labelops-bot: label queue 42 resumed by sam at 2026-03-22T20:10:00Z (automated note).
maya: uploaded deduped sample list -> /artifacts/curation/q6b_int4_dedupe_2026_03_22.csv
priya: running ash's no-cache sweep now (small dry-run) — will post numbers when done.
ash: posted small sweep results: int4 no-cache run shows recall drop reduced to ~2% (vs 6% earlier). seems kv-cache interplay amplified regressions.
eva: triage done on the 40 examples: 25 are hallucinations due to context truncation/incorrect token alignment after quantized attention. adding as labels: halluc_type=ctx_shift for those.
noah: i've pushed tokenizer_rev and longctx flag to sampling pipeline; new runs will include both in metadata.
priya: thanks team. plan: after maya + sam finalize micro-golden, we'll rerun the int4 candidate with deduped samples and no-cache to confirm. if regressions persist >3% we'll hold onboarding. paging @eng-runtime for FYI on kv-cache behavior.
sam: noted — i'll kick off labeling once micro-gold confirmed. expect a 24h turnaround for the microgold pass.
maya: will also add a short note to promptset docs about the tokenizer sensitivity and dedupe heuristic change.
priya: perfect. closing loop: will create a short PR with the results and tag infra/runtime for potential kernel fallback if we can't resolve the kv-cache issue. :thumbsup:
